title: Christmas greeting: the best gifts come from someone who paid attention
hook: Merry Christmas from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Merry Christmas from all of us at Galvor.

The gifts people remember are usually the ones that show someone was paying attention. We hope today brings you a few of those, and some proper rest.

The dashboards will keep until Monday.
alt_text: Festive greeting on a violet background with a Christmas tree: Merry Christmas. The best gifts come from someone who paid attention. Warm wishes from all of us at Galvor.
